answers.what: Deeper is a free add-on for AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini.
answers.does: It rewrites a basic request into a more detailed, expert-style prompt, including where to start, tools to use, and ways to check the result. It shows you the rewritten prompt and waits for your approval before anything runs.
answers.who: It is for people who want fuller, more expert-like answers from an AI assistant, even if they do not know what details to include.
